edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the constructor, granting full ownership privileges to an untrusted caller.
block.timestamp (now) plus 365 days determines releaseTime, making the lock duration depend on miner-controlled time.
Constructor assigns the _token argument to the token state variable.
Constructor assigns the _beneficiary argument to the beneficiary state variable.
Constructor writes releaseTime from a block.timestamp derived value.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable, changing access control rights.
The newOwner parameter flows directly into the transferOwnership state write.
The _token parameter flows into the TokenTimelock constructor.
The _beneficiary parameter flows into the TokenTimelock constructor.
The _releaseTime parameter flows into setReleaseTime.
setReleaseTime writes releaseTime and is protected only by the onlyOwner modifier.
The balanceOf return value is stored in the local amount variable.
release reads releaseTime to gate on the block timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp (now) is used inside release to satisfy the require(now >= releaseTime) check.
beneficiary is the destination address of the token transfer performed by the external call.
The token state variable is used by release to query the balance and to transfer.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before setReleaseTime executes.
release invokes token.balanceOf(this) to compute the transferable amount.
release executes an external token transfer, allowing the token contract to regain control before completion.
safeTransfer executes an external token.transfer call on an untrusted token contract.
safeTransferFrom executes an external token.transferFrom call on an untrusted token contract.
safeApprove executes an external token.approve call on an untrusted token contract.
SafeMath.mul performs a multiplication that could overflow before the assertion catches it.
SafeMath.add performs an addition that could overflow before the assertion catches it.
SafeMath.sub performs a subtraction that could underflow before the assertion catches it.
The constructor computes now + 365 days, an arithmetic operation on a timestamp value.
The release external call reaches the ERC20.transfer implementation and can re-enter the timelock while the balance is still held.
safeTransfer's external call dispatches into the token contract's transfer function, which may call back.
safeTransferFrom's external call dispatches into the token contract's transferFrom function, which may call back.
safeApprove's external call dispatches into the token contract's approve function, which may call back.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newOwner has no independent semantics; it is folded into the transferOwnership function that consumes it.
Parameter _token is only used to initialize state inside the constructor and should be merged into it.
Parameter _beneficiary is only assigned to the beneficiary state variable in the constructor.
Parameter _releaseTime is directly written into releaseTime by setReleaseTime.
The local amount is a transient buffer that is immediately consumed by the external token transfer call.
The local c is a temporary product used only inside SafeMath.mul and can be merged into the function.
